cost_rule: Report all five alternating pairs; no latency or throughput improvement gate. No tuning after costs are observed.
limits: Trusted cooperative POSIX graders; descendants escaping the process group are excluded.
Uncatchable death or suspension of the guard itself is excluded.
No machine power loss, hostile-code containment, exactly-once side effects or model capability claim.
Keep failed attempts and all raw observations.
primary_rule: All three candidate owner-loss cases stop grader and ordinary descendant within two seconds and resume token 2 to one independently replayable current result. Baseline must fail the same three cases.
stage: Development regression of an observed source defect; not a held-out model study. Frozen before paired measurement.
